task: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an fast paced round of TextWorld? You do! First of all, go north. And then, go to the east. And then, pick-up the cushion from the floor of the bedroom. And once you've done that, you win!
description:
You are in a bathroom. A normal one.

You see a dresser. Oh wow! Is that what I think it is? It is! It's a bench. The bench is typical. But there isn't a thing on it. Oh! Why couldn't there just be stuff on it? As if things weren't amazing enough already, you can even see a board. The board is standard. The board appears to be empty. You think about smashing the board to bits, throwing the bits in the dump, etc, until you get bored.

You don't like doors? Why not try going east, that entranceway is unguarded. You don't like doors? Why not try going north, that entranceway is unguarded. You don't like doors? Why not try going south, that entranceway is unblocked.

thought: I need to go north first as per the instructions.
